title: Procedural tiers 2-4: booleans, SDF, terrain, scatter, buildings
note: First captures of tiers 2-4, all built from recipes. Carved headstones are exact CSG with bevelled rims (a bevel loop that can't be cut is left sharp on its own, the rest still bevel); the rock is an SDF sculpt meshed by dual contouring; the crypt and the ruined wall come from the building generator with a brick texture graph baked on CPU workers; the graveyard plot is an eroded heightfield with splat colours and soil sides, with headstones scattered by Poisson-disc rules and rocks kept clear of them. 90 graves and 14 rocks are scattered as entities on the ground's heightfield collider (rays land at their feet; every rock at least 0.9 m from every grave). Close graveyard view: 8.6-10.5 ms GPU on the iGPU.
